sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS day, count(DISTINCT i.seller_id) AS m FROM orders.orders o JOIN orders.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(avg(m) FILTER (WHERE day >= DATE '2017-11-24'), 4) AS value, round(avg(m) FILTER (WHERE day < DATE '2017-11-24'), 4) AS baseline FROM d
